claimed_coverage: Tests that CustomOutput.to_rv() produces the expected single-line format ':CustomOutput         YEARLY AVERAGE PRECIP ENTIRE_WATERSHED' when the CustomOutput class inherits from LineCommand instead of FlatCommand.
fix_patch_grounding: The fix.patch changes CustomOutput from FlatCommand to LineCommand, which changes the output format of to_rv() from a flat/multi-line format (':CustomOutput\n\n:EndCustomOutput') to a single-line format with proper spacing (':CustomOutput         YEARLY AVERAGE PRECIP ENTIRE_WATERSHED').
issue_context_used: The issue describes that CustomOutput should render as a single line beginning with a colon followed by the command name and arguments with fixed whitespace, which the test verifies by asserting the exact output string.
notes: The eval.sh script runs the specific test_custom_ouputs test from test_commands.py which verifies the CustomOutput rendering behavior. The test fails without the fix (FlatCommand produces multi-line format) and passes with the fix (LineCommand produces correct single-line format). The RAVENPY_SKIP_TEST_DATA=1 environment variable is set to skip the automatic test data download fixture in conftest.py. The test.patch was copied to /artifacts/evaluation/test.patch as synthesis-time source material and is applied at runtime to add the test to the test file.
